name: pixellab_enhance_prompt
description:
Improve a prompt before generating, using Pixel Lab's prompt enhancers. Returns enhanced prompt text — pass it as the description to pixellab_generate/pixellab_animate. Does not create assets.
- pixen: description + params.image_size.
- character_v3: description + params.image_size.
- animation_v3: NO description — image_inputs.first_frame + params.action.

description.description: The draft prompt to enhance (pixen / character_v3).

params.description: Extra fields: image_size for pixen/character_v3; action for animation_v3.
